change: Always advertise SDR baseline independently of the optional HDR Static Metadata EDID block; HDR10/HLG checks unchanged
reason: Value 1 is BIT(SHDMI_SDR); old support logic incorrectly required HDR metadata EOTF bit0 even for ordinary SDR sinks
control_flow: Unsupported setter returns before changing eotf or MMIO; outer property setter swallows its error. This fix alone does not establish a flicker fix. Modeset requires a real display-info difference in atomic_check.
not_changed: display-info mask uses enum indexes rather than BIT(index); follow-up only if observed display-info changes justify it
